task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the sublist having minimum length.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method FindMinLengthSublist(lists: seq<seq<int>>) returns (sublist: seq<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned sublist is a sublist of one of the input lists
    - The length of the returned sublist is less than or equal to the length of any other sublist in the input lists
    - If multiple sublists have the minimum length, the returned sublist is one of them (any one is acceptable)
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method FindMinSublist(main: seq<int>, sub: seq<int>) returns (startIndex: int, length: int)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The sequences are not null
    - The subsequence length is less than or equal to the main sequence length
    
Dafny specification:
    requires |main| >= |sub|
    requires main != null
    requires sub != null
    
Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - If the subsequence exists in the main sequence, return the starting index of its first occurrence and its length
    - If the subsequence does not exist, return startIndex = -1 and length = 0
    
Dafny specification:
    ensures (exists i :: 0 <= i <= |main| - |sub| && main[i..i + |sub|] == sub) ==> startIndex >= 0 && startIndex <= |main| - |sub| && main[startIndex..startIndex + |sub|] == sub
    ensures (forall i :: 0 <= i < |main| - |sub| + 1 && main[i..i + |sub|] == sub) ==> startIndex == i
    ensures (main[..] !contains sub) ==> startIndex == -1 && length == 0
    ensures (startIndex >= 0) ==> length == |sub|
    ensures (startIndex >= 0) ==> main[startIndex..startIndex + length] == sub
    
Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method FindMinSublist(main: seq<int>, sub: seq<int>) returns (startIndex: int, length: int)
    requires main != null
    requires sub != null
    requires |main| >= |sub|
    ensures (exists i :: 0 <= i <= |main| - |sub| && main[i..i + |sub|] == sub) ==> startIndex >= 0 && startIndex <= |main| - |sub| && main[startIndex..startIndex + |sub|] == sub
    ensures (forall i :: 0 <= i < |main| - |sub| + 1 && main[i..i + |sub|] == sub) ==> startIndex == i
    ensures (main[..] !contains sub) ==> startIndex == -1 && length == 0
    ensures (startIndex >= 0) ==> length == |sub|
    ensures (startIndex >= 0) ==> main[startIndex..startIndex + length] == sub
{
    startIndex := -1;
    length := 0;
    var i := 0;
    while i <= |main| - |sub| 
        invariant 0 <= i <= |main| - |sub|
        invariant startIndex == -1 || (startIndex >= 0 && main[startIndex..startIndex + length] == sub)
        decreases |main| - i
    {
        if main[i..i + |sub|] == sub {
            startIndex := i;
            length := |sub|;
            // Since we want the minimal length sublist, we can break after first occurrence
            break;
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
